name: 黑金暖光参鸡汤滋补速食款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep black #0D0D0D stage for hero and food shots, pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust, soft cream #F5F1E8 for infographic screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm top light with gentle rising steam, soft contact shadows, appetizing realistic food rendering, never plastic-looking
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte black stone pot and dark slate; warm wood table for scenes; matte ceramic plates for ingredients
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent thin-line icons, single warm gold accent
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the pouch; served soup always in the same matte black stone pot; consistent product scale
styleLock.lockText: consistent premium dark nourishing food visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep black background #0D0D0D, cream text #F5F1E8, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one warm gold accent #C9A15C; soft warm top lighting with gentle steam and soft contact shadows, appetizing realistic food texture, never plastic-looking; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin-line icons in warm gold; matte black stone pot and dark slate surfaces with warm wood for scenes; stable slight 3/4 hero pouch angle and consistent product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking food.

provenance.notes: 从 5 张参鸡汤详情长图切片提炼（panel-01 至 panel-05）。已剥离：源品牌名与红标 logo、金色包装袋原图案、二维码与会员水印、图库水印、原文案（含抗癌/增强免疫力等不合规功效宣称、产地与检疫宣称）。产品一律以 {product} 占位。镜次补全说明：shot-01 白底主图仅由 panel-02 左上白底包装图弱支撑、shot-03 暖光餐桌场景与 shot-08 CTA 收口为按食品速食品类漏斗惯例的版式补全；shot-02 黑金石锅卖点（panel-01/02）、shot-04 配料俯拍（panel-04 食材平铺）、shot-05 炖鸡汤色特写（panel-04 特写）、shot-06 三步方法图（panel-03 烹饪方法 infographic）、shot-07 信任背书（panel-03/04 原料背书结构，证据位改为图内可验证的原料实拍细节）直接来自源片视觉语法。
